## Part 3 - Syscall surface (53)

Defined in `kernel/core/core_syscall.h` (`#define SYS_*`).
ABI: rax = number, rdi/rsi/rdx/r10 = arguments, rax = result
(>= 0 success, < 0 error). The authoritative list is the header;
the L1 syscall wrappers are declared in `l1/l1_wp8a.h`.
